Five Star Cooperative Agricultural Cooperative
Yielding Success for Over 100 Years
We are a farmer-owned agricultural supply cooperative based in New Hampton, Iowa that proudly serves rural communities across Northern Iowa and Southern Minnesota. As a full-service cooperative, we support individual farmers with farms of all sizes through our quality products, expert service, and commitment to long-term success.
View member benefits
Explore services
STAND TOGETHER
One Cooperative. One Team. Member-Driven. Thriving Forward.
At Five Star Cooperative, standing together means looking out for one another—on the farm and beyond. Through every challenge and every season, we grow stronger together.
View 2026 strategy
Cooperative Member Benefits
Why Join the Cooperative?
As a member of Five Star Cooperative, you’re part of a trusted ag coop with deep roots and shared rewards. Our members gain access to:
Increased buying power and lower input costs
Bulk purchasing and shared services
Competitive financing through RateStar and expert support
Patronage dividends and shared profits
Technical help in agronomy, energy, feed, and grain
Representation on our board of directors
A customized business dashboard through Five Star Link
When we work together, we grow together. That’s the cooperative advantage.
Agronomy
BETTER CROPS FOR YOUR FARM START HERE
We offer seed, fertilizer, crop protection and performance, and expert guidance, plus cutting-edge data and online tools to maximize your yield.
View agronomy products & services
Grain Elevators
Your Trusted LOCAL Grain Buyer
We provide competitive pricing, flexible delivery, and tailored service for corn and soybean farmers in Northern Iowa and Southern Minnesota.
View grain elevator services
Livestock Feed
Performance You Can Count On
From cattle and swine to horses and chickens, we offer premium feeds and custom nutrition plans.
View livestock products & services
Fuel & Propane
Safe, ReliablE ENERGY SOLUTIONS
We supply the energy to keep your operation moving including bulk diesel, gasoline, propane, DEF, and lubricants.
View energy products & services
Country Store
Farm & Home Essentials
Visit our Country Store in New Hampton for a wide range of farm and home supplies. From garden tools to pet feed, LP tank refills to pond stocking—we have the products you use every day, all in one place. We stake the claim that we are North Iowa’s largest sprayer parts supplier.
Get directions
View Country Store
Ag Input Financing
Smart financing, local support.
We understand the financial needs of farmers. With in-house financing through RateStar, you get low-interest loans for seed, fertilizer, fuel, LP, and other crop inputs. Enjoy easy applications, payment flexibility, and savings compared to traditional lenders built specifically for agricultural production.
Explore financing options
Our People
A Culture of Caring
Our success starts with our team. We invest in people through training, support, and a strong workplace culture. When we care for our team members, they deliver the outstanding service our members expect.
View career opportunities
Community Support
Five Star is dedicated to supporting local schools, 4-H and FFA programs, fire departments, and other community efforts. We believe strong farms grow from strong communities.
Learn about community engagement
Iowa Ag News
Stay Informed on Iowa Ag
Catch the latest updates on agriculture in Iowa. From local market insights to industry news, we keep you informed and connected.
